full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white pen-and-ink illustration shows a cloaked figure holding a bundle of wild stems against a nearly pure black ground. The upper half is dominated by an extravagant broad-brimmed hat. Its brim projects in a pale horizontal ellipse, while a tall pointed crown rises from a thicket of fine twiglike lines, leaves and small feathered forms. The figure stands in the lower-left and middle part of the frame, turned slightly toward the right. A dark shadow cast by the hat conceals most of the face, leaving only a pale neck, a hint of nose and the high collar clearly visible. Heavy layered cloth falls around the shoulders and torso, its folds built from dense crosshatching and short white scratches. Both hands gather several thin stalks close to the chest. Their leaves and branching tips open toward the right, where a small glowing speck appears in the surrounding darkness. Tiny white dots and sprayed-looking marks drift through the right side, suggesting airborne dust or light without defining a location. The bright hat edge, hands and plant forms separate sharply from the black background, while many interior contours are deliberately lost in shadow. The light appears to come from the upper right, picking out the fine edges of stems, brim and sleeves. The overall composition is compact and mysterious, its highly worked silvery line texture set against a wide, silent field of black.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白钢笔墨线插画里，一个披斗篷的人物抱着一束野生枝茎，身后几乎是纯黑色。上半部由一顶夸张的宽檐帽主导。帽檐向外伸成浅亮的横向椭圆，高而尖的帽冠则从细密的枝条状线、叶片和小羽状形体中升起。人物站在画面左下及中部，身体略向右转。帽子投下的深影遮住大部分脸，只留下浅亮颈部、少许鼻形和高领较清楚。厚重多层布料垂在肩背和躯干周围，褶皱由密集交叉排线与短白刮痕构成。双手在胸前收拢几根细长枝茎。枝叶和分叉尖端朝右展开，那里有一个细小发亮点处在周围黑暗中。细白点和似喷洒的痕迹飘在右侧，暗示空中的微尘或光，却不限定地点。浅亮帽缘、双手和枝叶从黑背景中尖锐分离，许多内部轮廓则刻意消失在阴影里。光似乎来自右上，挑出枝茎、帽檐和衣袖的纤细边缘。整体构图紧凑而神秘，精密加工的银色线条肌理与宽阔无声的黑域相对。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome ink treatment creates form through minute white linework, dense crosshatching and stippled points emerging from a deep black field. Major silhouettes are clear at their lit edges but allow internal detail to disappear into shadow. Slender branching strokes contrast with broad dark fabriclike masses, producing an intricate yet readable hierarchy. Illumination is selective and directional: small pale accents gather near the center while the surrounding ground remains almost entirely unbroken. The limited silver-gray scale and generous negative space give the densely worked marks room to breathe. The overall effect is nocturnal, delicate and slightly uncanny, with texture carrying both volume and atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色墨线处理让细密白线、交叉排线与点状痕迹从深黑底中浮出，建立形体。主要剪影在受光边缘清楚，内部细节却容许消失于暗影。细长分枝状笔触与宽阔深色布料式量块相对，形成繁复却可读的层级。照明有选择且有方向：小块浅亮强调集中在中心附近，周围底色几乎完全不断裂。有限的银灰色阶与宽裕负空间，让密集笔痕有呼吸余地。整体效果幽夜般、纤巧而稍显离奇，肌理同时承担体积与气氛。
theme_en: A cloaked figure holding wild stems beneath an elaborate pointed hat
theme_zh: 披斗篷的人物戴着繁复尖帽，手捧野生枝叶
name: Nico Delort
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
